messages:
Omar El-Sayed: Hi everyone — I accepted the org invite but when I go to https://github.com/redwood/intro-lab I get a 404. Clone fails too: 'Permission denied (publickey)'. Not sure who to ping. :wave:
Maya Li: welcome Omar! Quick checks: did you complete the org SSO flow and enable 2FA? Also, are you logged into the right GitHub account in your browser?
Omar El-Sayed: I clicked the authorize button during the invite. I do have 2FA. I only have one GH account (username omar-e).
Tom Baker: can you run `ssh -T git@github.com` and `gh auth status` and paste output (no tokens)?
Omar El-Sayed: `ssh -T git@github.com` -> "Hi omar-e! You've successfully authenticated, but GitHub does not provide shell access."
Omar El-Sayed: `gh auth status` -> "Logged into github.com as omar-e (OAuth)"
Maya Li: SSH and gh show you're authenticated. 404 + successful SSH usually points to team mapping or email alias mismatch. Did the invite go to your work email or a different alias?
Omar El-Sayed: The invite was to o.el-sayed@redwood.com. On GH my primary email is o.el-sayed+personal@gmail.com but I added and verified the work address too.
Tom Baker: sometimes the browser session still uses the old account. Try signing out of github.com in the browser, clear cookies for github.com, or open an Incognito window and accept/authorize the org SSO there. That fixed it for me before.
Omar El-Sayed: I signed out, cleared cookies, re-authorized SSO in incognito. Still 404 when visiting the repo URL. clone returns same permission error.
RepoBot: Automated check: org membership OK, SSO status: authorized, 2FA: enabled, team assignment: NOT FOUND.
Maya Li: thanks RepoBot. Omar, looks like the auto team mapping didn't run. @Tom can you add Omar to the `eng-onboarding` team and give write access to intro-lab?
Tom Baker: adding Omar to eng-onboarding now... done. Omar, refresh the repo page.
Omar El-Sayed: Repo visible now, thanks! Cloned successfully. One follow-up: trying to push to main error: "remote: error: protected branch update rejected" — is that expected for the lab repo?
Maya Li: yes, main is protected. For intro-lab create a branch and open a PR. Also note we require commit email to match work address for CLA checks.
Omar El-Sayed: My local git used my personal email. I'll update: `git config --global user.email "o.el-sayed@redwood.com"` and amend the commit.
Tom Baker: if you already pushed, you can amend and force-push to your feature branch; don't force-push main.
Omar El-Sayed: Fixed and PR opened. Everything green. Thanks for the quick help everyone! :tada:
IT-Support-Bot: If anyone else hits the 404+SSH-auth combo: try (1) verify work email on GH, (2) re-authorize SSO in a fresh browser session, (3) confirm team mapping in the org console; ping #new-hires if mapping looks stuck.
